mentions.name: c3n.ro
mentions.description: A paid email service that lets users bring their own domain and create as many aliases and inboxes as they need, hosted in the EU as a self-made alternative to mainstream providers. It will eventually be available at c3n.ro.
mentions.problem: The author no longer wants to use existing mainstream email providers like Gmail, Tuta, or Proton.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on email. Principles are growing stronger and for some reason I don't want to use Gmail/Tuta/Proton anymore, so I'm _making my own_. It'll be paid and you'll be able to bring your own domain and however many aliases/inboxes you need.

It'll eventually be at c3n.ro and will be "sovereignly" hosted in the EU.
